name: Data from Local System
summary: Adversaries may target and collect data from local system sources, such as file systems, configuration files, or local databases. This can include sensitive data such as specifications, schematics, or diagrams of control system layouts, devices, and processes. strategies.name: Detection of Data from Local System

analytics.name: Analytic 1881
analytics.guidance: Monitor Windows Security Event ID 4663 on explicitly audited ICS data paths and correlate repeated ReadData/ListDirectory access across multiple sensitive files or directories by an account/process outside the approved engineering, backup, or application baseline. This requires Object Access auditing and SACLs on the monitored paths; Sysmon does not provide generic file-read telemetry. Alert when the bulk-read pattern occurs outside an approved backup/export window or is followed by staging, compression, or network transfer.

analytics.name: Analytic 2137
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a Linux process performing sequential reads across multiple ICS configuration or data paths by a UID outside approved backup, engineering, or vendor-application accounts. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2174
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies large outbound data transfers from Industrial Control System (ICS) server Internet Protocol (IP) addresses to destinations outside the approved ICS zone, following a pattern of bulk reads from engineering document stores or historian databases. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
